nom: Olay Retinol Night Cream for Women

avis.titre: From my 20s to my 60s – Olay Never Disappoints!
avis.texte: I have been using this Olay Regenerist Night Cream with retinol for several years, and I absolutely LOVE how soft it makes my skin feel. My relationship with Olay actually started many years ago when I met a 99-year-old woman who looked 20 years younger. Her secret? Oil of Olay every night. She was all the proof I needed to become a lifelong customer. Now that I am approaching 60, my skin needs much more intensive moisture than it did in my twenties, and this night cream delivers perfectly. What I Love: • Texture & Application: It goes on incredibly smooth and even. • Scent: It doesn't smell like anything but clean. • Deep Hydration: It leaves my skin feeling remarkably soft and plump by morning. Things to note: It takes about 15-20 minutes to absorb fully. If I don't wait before going to bed, it sticks to my sleep mask. I plan to use this until I’m 99 myself, and I hope I can pass this skincare secret along to the next generation! Highly recommend.

I use the OLAY RETINOL NIGHT CREAM 24 as an integral part of my nightly regiment. The retinal 24 has a concentration of hydrators for deep skin transformation. I have noticed in the past few weeks that the fine lines are barely visible. The cream is absorbed quickly with a non-greasy finish. My skin is visibly smoother and brighter. The price I pay for Olay retinol night cream 24 is well worth it: a little dab on your cheeks, forehead neck and lip area means the cream will last for at least a month. I have learned that just a little goes a long way. So if you want, you’re fine lines to disappear and less deep wrinkles, use this product. 24 hours of hydration!
Really like this cream. Moisturizes well without being greasy. My skin feels nice and smooth after application. It has no fragrance. This is my go-to night cream.
I like Olay night cream with retinol because it leaves my skin softer, hydrated and with a firmer appearance. I use it at night and I feel my face more renewed and luminous.
Olay has done it again! Love this , use it at night and a little definitely goes a long way. Use it with the Olay daytime cream and my skin looks great.

avis.titre: It is not sticky and it moisturizer very nicely.
avis.texte: I just started using this Olay Retinol night cream is excellent and it goes on very smoothly.
Great product — on the pricey side. Also, the heavy-duty cardboard that these products are shipped is almost impossible to open.
Great moisturizer. Can be worn under makeup. Leaves skin feeling smooth.

avis.titre: One of the best night creams
avis.texte: I really like this product and I am using it regularly as my night cream. It gives perfect moisture to the skin and makes my skin look refreshed in the morning.
No irrita y deja la piel suave y tersa. Todavía no he notado ninguna reducción de arrugas.
Bought this for my 80yo mother and she loves how it makes wrinkles disappear through a daily night regime. In two weeks, she noticed considerable softening of the appearance of wrinkles.
I was recommended this product and I totally get why. It feels like butter on my face! Been using for 3 weeks and can totally tell a difference

avis.titre: Unexpected benefit for treatment of burn!
avis.texte: Four weeks ago I was making bacon in the oven. In the process of pulling it out of the oven, I accidentally spilled 400 degree bacon grease on my left hand. There were second degree burns on my hand. I ran cold water over my hand and wrapped it for about 7 days. At that point, the damaged skin turned black and sloughed off. The newly exposed skin looked very raw and likely to scar. I have a lot of allergies. I applied Oil of Olay Regenerist to the wound because I knew I’m not allergic to it. This is by no means a clinical trial, but Regenerist certainly seemed to accelerate the healing. Within another 7 days, almost all signs of the burn were gone. I wonder if there is an active ingredient in this product that has clinical applications for burns?
Actually insane , only a week of use and my dark circles cleared up so much.

avis.titre: I think it’s working but some flaking and tender skin...
avis.texte: 45 yr old female, writing this after 4 nights using the nighttime olay regenerist 24 face cream (+ the regenerist serum and eye cream). I first thought I hadn’t washed my face well enough this morning but upon closer inspection realize that what I am seeing is actually a thin layer of my skin peeling off (see attached picture). This is in little patches. I have read this is normal the first few weeks using a retinol cream, so we will see what happens... I also feel a little itchy and have some irritation- especially around my eyes (assuming from the eye cream). I read on a medical site that this too is normal and that it should subside in a few weeks/ to tough it out if possible. Aspirin or ibuprofen are recommended for quick relief. My thoughts- I can deal with the flaky peely skin since I’m working from home the next few weeks- but only if it’s temporary. Because I think the peeling would be noticeable even with makeup. I will try to post an update in a few weeks.
I received my order faster than expected but when I opened the package the cap was open and half the product was spilled inside the box.
I’m amazed on how great this moisturizing night cream work!!!

avis.titre: My Go-To Retinol Night Cream at 58
avis.texte: I’m 58 and I have sensitive skin, so I really appreciate that this cream is fragrance-free and gentle on my skin. It feels smooth and lightweight, absorbs well, and doesn’t feel greasy, which makes it comfortable to use every night. It hydrates my skin and helps it look softer, smoother, and more refreshed. Over time, my skin also looks brighter and more even in texture. I’ve noticed my fine lines and wrinkles look a little softer, and dark spots and uneven tone appear gradually improved. It works gently overnight to help support skin renewal and repair visible signs of aging. When I wake up, my skin looks more rested, smoother, and healthier. Overall, for my sensitive skin, this is one of the best night creams I’ve used because it’s gentle, fragrance-free, and still gives visible results with consistent use.

avis.titre: Do not get what you pay for
avis.texte: Opened the product today and it only had 1/4 to 1/3 of the product inside. The lid was not securely on the jar but nothing appeared to have spilled out. I took pictures and did not use. I am disappointed that I paid 46.99 and got so little of the product. I will try to return for a refund. I gave it one star because I did not use due to the fact it had very little in the jar!!!!

Used this product on my face and neck, before going to bed. Woke up to itching and burning! Immediately washed the area but the damage was done! Ended up going to urgent care after 3 days because it was getting worse, doctor said it was indeed a reaction and because of me itching it became infected! Day 4 of antibiotics.....

avis.titre: Are use this product for a couple weeks made me break out in boils on my skin and also a lot of acne
avis.texte: Are use this product for a couple weeks made me break out in boils on my skin and also a lot of acne I read it as one of the worst products of ever tried for my face never again
I have been trying this product for five months, I see no difference, none whatsoever it did not work at all for me
Product came almost empty, remaining product is not fit for use, its not creamy its rubbery
Terrible. DO NOT BUY. Package was damaged and spilled everywhere and labeled “not for resale.”
This product did not smooth wrinkles and gave me a rash instead.

I haven’t even used it yet. I literally just had it deliver 5 minutes ago and when I opened it I was rather disappointed. It appears to not be any where near full 😕 and for the price it really should be. Here’s to hoping it’s a good product

I tend to have naturally decent skin without breakouts. I do occasionally struggle with excess oily-ness. The picture included in this review is 100% unedited, bathroom lighting, no make-up, and no filters - to show my skin type. I am 29 years old and am starting to take an interest in anti-aging skin care. I routinely moisturize with an SPF 30 face cream in the mornings and have added this to my night time regime. I have tried a handful of different night time moisturizers just to switch things up. This one was a little pricier compared to what I usually spend but that's likely because of the retinol. Overall, I like this moisturizer. I apply it in the evenings, after washing my face, before bedtime. It's not too thick or too light and a little goes a long way. I like how soft it makes my skin feel the next morning. I have not noticed any major improvements in my skin since using this product, although I did not expect much as I'm still young. I will continue to use this product on a daily basis as part of my skin care routine. I will also continue to purchase it from Amazon as long as the pricing remains competitive.

avis.titre: My wife says it makes her skin feel like silk!
avis.texte: My wife is very pleased with this nighttime cream. Olay never seems to disappoint with their skincare products! My wife says this cream applies so nicely to her skin and a little goes a long way! Once massaged in it made her skin feel like silk! Even the next morning her skin was still so soft! She thinks this cream is just amazing and it’s nice that you get a travel size whip with it too!

avis.titre: Rejuvenate Night & Day - TWO Face Creams
avis.texte: The Overnight Moisturizing Magic is thick and fragrance free for hydrating at night. I'm applying this before bed and I'm seeing the finer lines on my cheeks (under my eyes) reduced -- this has Retinol and Vitamin B3 -- Retinol is one of the best things I can use on my skin to boost collagen and reduce wrinkles. The Whip isn't as thick. It's for daytime. It's also great at hydrating. Both of these are fragrance-free and have no dyes or fillers.

avis.titre: Not greasy and made my skin feel amazing
avis.texte: This night cream really surprised me. I assumed would be heavy and greasy. It goes on very light and leaves a pleasant feeling. I struggle with oily skin - but after I started using this - my oil production subsided. This also comes with a week supply of day/night moisturizer . PROS: Lightweight NOT GREASY Leaves a pleasant matte feeling Container lasts a long time CONS Expensive . (the price is all over the place online.) Make sure to look around

My skin lost its brightness. It’s started to look dull and dry. It made my skin very sensitive to all several other Olay products. Trying to figure out with my doctor what’s changed in my regimen and that’s been the ONLy thing. I love olay products. Not impressed with this night cream. Will be discarding the rest. Hopefully my skin will come back to life. I constantly got compliments in my skin. Now nothing. I even have a burn mark on my face. So disappointed!

The first night I used this it was fine but after a few days it's started to burn my skin. My face is very tight, shiny and red but my neck has by far the worst of it. Hopefully it doesn't scar. After going through the reviews I see many people experienced this same thing. So just be aware it's a gamble. And when it comes to your face I would not take a gamble.

I don't have sensitive skin at all. Never have and thus was the result of using it for a month. It dried my skin out and it made it red and flakey. Don't buy this. Smelt good and clean. But that's the only thing it has going for it. And I mean it did it to my neck too but I thought it was my perfume until I saw it happen to my face and discontinued use of the perfume. Idk what Olay did but they messed this one up bad.

I've been using this every day for the last three months along with the Olay Regenerist Micro-Sculpting Face Cream in the Red Jar in the mornings and have noticed a slight change in my skin. The change is subtle but there is definite plumping and hydration. The texture of my skin is more smooth and it feels supple. I wanted more of an effect so began to use other products in combination with Olay and have started to see a more drastic improvement. I do love the feeling of this cream as it smears so beautifully across the skin and sinks in almost immediately leaving no greasy residue. This is a wonderful product, but I see it more as a daily maintenance cream than a reparative treatment. It is definitely a good item to have in the tool kit, but use it along with a great serum for maximum results.

When I researched this product I knew that using a lot of retinol would cause irritation. I expected a tiny bit of irritation because your skin has to get used to retinol and over time it's suppose to get better...at least that's what I was told. I used this product nightly for about a month and a half. Initially there was some stinging but it soon went away. It wasn't until a few weeks into using it that my neck would itch after application and then it started itching more than usual. I hadn't been paying much attention to my neck area until one night my neck was irritating me so I took a look at it and I see burns!!!! I hadn't even noticed! Very disappointed. I thought OTC retinol products were low in strength and I wouldn't have to worry about it burning my skin, but obviously I was wrong! So I will not be using this product again!!!!

Estoy decepcionada. Hoy recibí mi crema Olay Retinol 24 y llegó endurecida, como una bolita de goma. Es una pena, porque ya la he usado antes y sé que es un producto excelente. Sin embargo, algo debió fallar en su conservación o almacenamiento. Lo peor es que no puedo devolverla porque actualmente me encuentro fuera de EE. UU.

avis.titre: Doesn't Absorb Well – Leaves Flaky Residue
avis.texte: This lotion is supposed to help repair the skin, but it doesn’t absorb well at all. It leaves a residue that flakes off—just look at the picture of my leather couch where it’s visibly shedding. I can even feel it on my face when I touch it. For such an expensive product and a brand with this reputation, I expected much better quality. Very disappointing.

avis.titre: Retinol will burn your skin! DO NOT BUY!!!!
avis.texte: I've always used oil of olay (old skool) fpr over 40 years and decided to try a new one but for wrinkles. I used this product 2 days and I didn't understand why my face was always on fire even when water would touch it after I used it. I couldn't deal with tue peeling ,dryness and redness along with puffiness. I feel a lawsuit coming on since there is no disclaimer about the retinol. Watch out Olay.

While the packaging box was intact, the bottom of the product box was opened, the lid was off the cream, and at least, 1/2 the cream was smeared all over the inside. It was gross. I will be returning.

avis.titre: I’m a little Skeptical of this seller?
avis.texte: I have used the product for the last few days, And I am a little skeptical. I was hoping for some instruction, ingredients or anything about the product however is not packaged for individual sale and the QR codes don’t work.

The product is lovely under normal circumstances. This seller should be ashamed. The packages were all opened. There was food in the box. And there was a “sell only at CVS” sticker on the top of the larger product. There is no way I would trust this on my skin. I requested a refund, but watch out for this seller. Again, the product, when purchased from a reputable dealer, is lovely.
